---
title: "Test report target"
subtitle: "Throwaway report to test quarto_report() in _targets.R — delete with its outputs"
---

{{< include ../_provenance.qmd >}}

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(targets)
library(ggplot2)
source("tools/R/provenance.R")
out <- report_dir()   # this report's folder in output/reports/latest/
```

## Data

The upstream target `test_report_data` (random values, made in the pipeline):

```{r}
df <- tar_read(test_report_data)
head(df)
summary(df)
```

## A function call inside the report

```{r}
summarise_groups <- function(d) {
  aggregate(value ~ group, data = d, FUN = function(v) c(mean = mean(v), var = var(v)))
}
summarise_groups(df)
```

## Plot

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Random values per group."
p <- ggplot(df, aes(group, value, fill = group)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1) +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(file.path(out, "test-plot.png"), p, width = 6, height = 4)
p
```
